instruction: Set the editor font size to 18 in VS Code's user settings.

command: cd /home/user/Downloads && unzip -q vscodeEvalExtension.zip && code --install-extension vscodeEvalExtension/eval-0.0.1.vsix && rm -rf vscodeEvalExtension vscodeEvalExtension.zip

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened the project folder in VS Code by clicking Open Folder in the Explorer sidebar, navigating to /home/user, selecting the project folder, and clicking Open. Completed in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code UI, use Open Folder dialog, click buttons, select items from dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model demonstrated VS Code UI navigation ability, this variation tests a related but harder task: modifying a user setting through the VS Code settings UI.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the editor font size to 18 in VS Code user settings. Evaluator uses check_json_settings to verify the setting was persisted to settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vscode_config) correctly reads VS Code user settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json using the VS Code extension command to ensure the file is current.

Metric (check_json_settings) correctly receives the rules dict via get_rule and accesses expected['expected'] to get {'editor.fontSize': 18}, then verifies each key-value pair exists in the actual settings JSON.
Expected value 'editor.fontSize: 18' directly and completely matches the instruction requirement to set editor font size to 18.
Single-requirement instruction is fully covered by the evaluator - no missing verification steps.
Postconfig properly activates VS Code window before getter execution.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
